## Summary

Describe the user-visible and technical change.

## Validation

List the commands, automated tests, and Moodle flows you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behaviour, configuration, compatibility, or operations changed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or production credentials are included.
- [ ] Generated AMD files are included when required by the source change.
